plugins.name: content-ai
plugins.description: AI-powered content generation plugin with skills for deep-dive research, branded presentations, and LinkedIn publishing.

plugins.name: agentic-ai
plugins.description: Agentic engineering plugin with complex and simplified architecture planning, workspace-grounded onboarding, and agent-memory workflows.

plugins.name: general-ops
plugins.description: Bidirectional Copilot CLI remote-control bridges — step away from the terminal and keep the agent running by chatting with it from Microsoft Teams or Telegram. Progress, questions, completion markers, and requested file attachments post outbound; your replies auto-inject back into the session.

plugins.name: general-mcp
plugins.description: Bundles ready-to-use MCP servers, registered user-wide across all repos on install: Playwright (browser automation), Azure DevOps/ADO (work items, repos, pipelines), and Azure (azmcp). Servers launch locally via npx; auth reuses your existing az login / Azure CLI session.

plugins.name: remote-plugin-blader
plugins.description: Vendored skill from blader/humanizer: humanizer — removes signs of AI-generated writing to make text read as natural, human-written prose.

plugins.name: remote-plugin-obra
plugins.description: Vendored skill from obra/superpowers: brainstorming — explores intent, requirements, and design before implementation.

plugins.name: remote-plugin-199-biotechnologies
plugins.description: Vendored skill from 199-biotechnologies/claude-deep-research-skill: deep-research — multi-source research with citation tracking and structured reports.

plugins.name: local-ai
plugins.description: Invokes a separately-installed LocalAIExecution `localai` CLI to generate images locally on your own NVIDIA GPU (FLUX text-to-image) via its stable --json subprocess contract. Discovers the external tool at runtime and vendors none of its code.

plugins.name: code-simplifier
plugins.description: Agent that simplifies and refines code for clarity, consistency, and maintainability while preserving functionality. Focuses on recently modified code.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Create distinctive, production-grade frontend interfaces with high design quality. Generates creative, polished code that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.
